mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of months where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), a CPIAUCSL reading above 6.0% year-over-year signals persistent inflation that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, CPIAUCSL > 6.0% fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates strong household demand, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100) in a single month, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of months where INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and an increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to inflation fears.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and rise in PAYEMS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply chain disruption regime (INDPRO < 100.0), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400.0 (thousands of units) signals further economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 100.0, HOUST < 1400.0 fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
